name: VSA & Orderflow v4.0 Monitor (.NET 8 WebSocket)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  push:
    paths:
      - 'VsaMonitor/**'
      - '.github/workflows/vsa_monitor.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      test_notify:
        description: 'Enviar mensaje de prueba a Telegram'
        required: false
        default: '1'
      build_windows_exe:
        description: 'Compilar también ejecutable autónomo para Windows (.exe)'
        required: false
        default: '1'

concurrency:
  group: vsa-monitor-v4
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  monitor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 7

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repositorio
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configurar .NET 8 SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Cachear binario compilado (Linux x64)
        id: bin-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: dist/linux-x64
          key: vsa-bin-linux-${{ hashFiles('VsaMonitor/**') }}

      - name: Compilar ejecutable autónomo Linux (Self-Contained SingleFile)
        if: steps.bin-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          dotnet publish VsaMonitor/VsaMonitor.csproj \
            -c Release \
            -r linux-x64 \
            --self-contained true \
            -p:PublishSingleFile=true \
            -o dist/linux-x64
          chmod +x dist/linux-x64/VsaMonitor

      - name: Compilar ejecutable autónomo Windows (.exe) bajo demanda o push
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.build_windows_exe == '1')
        run: |
          dotnet publish VsaMonitor/VsaMonitor.csproj \
            -c Release \
            -r win-x64 \
            --self-contained true \
            -p:PublishSingleFile=true \
            -o dist/win-x64

      - name: Publicar ejecutables compilados como Artifacts
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: VsaMonitor-v4-binaries
          path: |
            dist/linux-x64/VsaMonitor
            dist/win-x64/VsaMonitor.exe
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Restaurar estado y Paper Trading (state.json + paper_state.json)
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: |
            state.json
            paper_state.json
          key: vsa-state-v4-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: |
            vsa-state-v4-

      - name: Ejecutar monitor C# WebSocket en tiempo real
        env:
          TELEGRAM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID }}
          LOOP_SECONDS: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && '30' || '260' }}
          TEST_NOTIFY: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.test_notify || '0' }}
          VSA_WORKDIR: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: ./dist/linux-x64/VsaMonitor

      - name: Guardar estado y Paper Trading
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: |
            state.json
            paper_state.json
          key: vsa-state-v4-${{ github.run_id }}
